summary: Tiny steep kerb at a bend, flats and houses 14 m away.
reasons: Only 16 m long, bend in road

best_section.where: Kings Road east kerb at the bend, by the sunken garden

drivers.seclusion: Apartments and a detached house 14 m away across the road; more flats within 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow kerb on a bend with a car already parked at the end; room is tight.
drivers.convention: A few cars park nearby, none clearly overnight.

sun_shade: Open sky with trees and shrubs along the kerb; sun from the east and west.
